description: The tokens every HopeLab theme shares. A theme file sets each required token; the rest fall back to the default here. 'css' is the custom property the CSS generator writes; Avalonia keys are 'Lab.' plus the name in Pascal case.

tokens.name: surface.canvas
tokens.description: The application canvas behind everything; also the colour painted before a theme loads.

tokens.name: surface.panel
tokens.description: Panels and cards on the canvas.

tokens.name: surface.elevated
tokens.description: Dialogs, popups and anything raised above a panel.

tokens.name: surface.header
tokens.description: The shell header, and the start of its gradient.

tokens.name: surface.header-end
tokens.description: The end of the header gradient.

tokens.name: surface.sidebar
tokens.description: The sidebar, and the start of its gradient.

tokens.name: accent.primary
tokens.description: Primary actions and the active item. In CORA: STORE.

tokens.name: accent.highlight
tokens.description: New things and highlights. In CORA: CREATE.

tokens.name: accent.link
tokens.description: Links and relationships. In CORA: MERGE.

tokens.name: accent.info
tokens.description: Information and lookups. In CORA: RETRIEVE.

tokens.name: accent.success
tokens.description: Success states only.

tokens.name: accent.error
tokens.description: Error states only; kept apart from accent.primary.

tokens.name: accent.warning
tokens.description: Unknown or not-yet-reported states, and warnings.

tokens.name: ink.icon
tokens.description: An icon drawn on an accent fill. Must reach 4.5:1 on every accent.

tokens.name: ink.overlay
tokens.description: The ink of translucent overlays (hairlines, hover washes): light on a dark theme, dark on a light one.

tokens.name: persona.face
tokens.description: The assistant's own plates and features.

tokens.name: persona.live
tokens.description: Live traffic, and nothing else.

tokens.name: persona.mane
tokens.description: The mass the assistant's face emerges from.

tokens.name: persona.hot
tokens.description: Reserved for where the assistant is looking.

tokens.name: persona.signature
tokens.description: The theme's signature colour on the assistant's face.

tokens.name: text.primary
tokens.description: Body text.

tokens.name: text.secondary
tokens.description: Secondary text: captions, hints, metadata.

tokens.name: text.mono
tokens.description: Monospaced data text (identifiers, timestamps, status).

tokens.name: text.disabled
tokens.description: Disabled text. Exempt from contrast floors.

tokens.name: border.header
tokens.description: The rule under the header.

tokens.name: border.subtle
tokens.description: Hairlines between rows and panels.

tokens.name: border.input
tokens.description: Text boxes and other inputs at rest.

tokens.name: border.focus
tokens.description: The focus ring.

tokens.name: gradient.header
tokens.description: The header's fill.

tokens.name: gradient.sidebar
tokens.description: The sidebar's fill.

tokens.name: gradient.user-bubble
tokens.description: A chat message from the user.

tokens.name: gradient.assistant-bubble
tokens.description: A chat message from the assistant.

tokens.name: glow.primary
tokens.description: A glow in accent.primary.

tokens.name: glow.info
tokens.description: A glow in accent.info.

tokens.name: glow.link
tokens.description: A glow in accent.link.

tokens.name: glow.node-active
tokens.description: The glow around the active node in a graph; usually the node's own colour.

tokens.name: glow.highlight
tokens.description: A glow in accent.highlight.

tokens.name: glow.highlight-hover
tokens.description: The highlight glow under the pointer.

tokens.name: glow.link-strong
tokens.description: A strong glow in accent.link.

tokens.name: viz.series-1
tokens.description: Chart series 1. A non-text mark: 3:1 on the panel.

tokens.name: viz.series-2
tokens.description: Chart series 2. A non-text mark: 3:1 on the panel.

tokens.name: viz.series-3
tokens.description: Chart series 3. A non-text mark: 3:1 on the panel.

tokens.name: viz.series-4
tokens.description: Chart series 4. A non-text mark: 3:1 on the panel.

tokens.name: viz.grid
tokens.description: Chart grid lines.

tokens.name: viz.axis
tokens.description: Chart axes and their labels.

tokens.name: viz.heat-1
tokens.description: Heat scale, step 1 of 5 (cool to hot).

tokens.name: viz.heat-2
tokens.description: Heat scale, step 2 of 5 (cool to hot).

tokens.name: viz.heat-3
tokens.description: Heat scale, step 3 of 5 (cool to hot).

tokens.name: viz.heat-4
tokens.description: Heat scale, step 4 of 5 (cool to hot).

tokens.name: viz.heat-5
tokens.description: Heat scale, step 5 of 5 (cool to hot).

tokens.name: persona.line
tokens.description: Multiplier on the stroke width of the assistant's seams, features and eyes.

tokens.name: persona.plate
tokens.description: Multiplier on the alpha of the assistant's plates.

tokens.name: persona.seam
tokens.description: Multiplier on the alpha of the assistant's seams and features.

tokens.name: persona.glow
tokens.description: Blur in pixels around the assistant's features and eyes; 0 is none.

tokens.name: persona.chrome
tokens.description: Which signature detail the theme's chrome draws, by theme id, or none.

tokens.name: font.mono
tokens.description: Monospaced text.

tokens.name: font.body
tokens.description: Body and interface text.

tokens.name: font.display
tokens.description: Page and section headings.

tokens.name: font.surface
tokens.description: Text drawn on the theme's own chrome (panels, plates, labels).

tokens.description: Page titles: weight.

tokens.description: Subheadings: weight.

tokens.name: type.body.size
tokens.description: Body text: size.

tokens.name: type.body.weight
tokens.description: Body text: weight.

tokens.name: type.body.line-height

tokens.name: type.label.size

tokens.description: Labels and buttons: weight.

tokens.name: type.micro.size
tokens.description: The smallest text: badges, footnotes: size.

tokens.description: The smallest text: badges, footnotes: weight.

tokens.description: Section spacing, panel gutters.
